name: Asadullah Faisal
bio: I'm a final-year AI & Data Science student at IIT Jodhpur. I build machine learning systems and then measure where they break: a text detector for Indian street signs, an LLM agent that cannot act without permission, and the benchmarks that keep both honest.
about: My research, under Prof. Anand Mishra, is on finding text in photos of Indian streets. The result I am proudest of so far came from an audit, not a new model: the detector was skipping the normalization it was trained with, and fixing that one step raised recall without any retraining.

On the software side I like systems where the model is powerful but not trusted: OpsPilot lets an LLM investigate production incidents, while a server-side policy engine, a human reviewer and a verification step decide what actually happens.
I care about evaluation as much as building. Every project here comes with its numbers, including the ones that did not go my way.
